stale.title: Inactive
stale.rule: No new video in 180 days or more.

ignored.title: Not watched
ignored.rule: 8 or more videos in the last 90 days, none of them watched.
ignored.needs_history: Needs the watch history from the browser extension to find these.

off_profile.title: Off your profile
off_profile.rule: Far from the folders and favorites you use most, according to Hermes.

manual.title: Marked by you
manual.rule: You marked these to cancel in Manage.

selection.label: Selection
selection.none: Pick channels or a whole group. Nothing is cancelled until you confirm.

approve.description: Nothing happens until you confirm here.
approve.effect_one: The browser extension will cancel {count} subscription on YouTube, in your browser.
approve.effect_other: The browser extension will cancel {count} subscriptions on YouTube, in your browser, one at a time.
approve.effect_resubscribe: You can resubscribe for {days} days from Ex-subscriptions.
approve.effect_undo: Until it runs, you can undo it in the queue.
approve.effect_offline: The extension is offline: it stays in the queue until your browser opens.
approve.refused: Approval refused: only a click here, in Hermes Desktop, approves a cancellation.

resub.title: Resubscribe to {name}?
resub.description: It goes through the same queue as cancellations.
resub.effect: The browser extension will subscribe to {name} again on YouTube, in your browser.
resub.effect_undo: Until it runs, you can undo it in the queue.

queue.title: Queue
queue.description: The browser extension runs one at a time, with a short pause between them.
queue.label: Cancellation queue

status.approved_offline: approved · waits until your browser opens

note.not_subscribed: Already unsubscribed on YouTube; nothing was clicked.
note.already_subscribed: Already subscribed on YouTube; nothing was clicked.

ex.title: Ex-subscriptions
ex.description: Cancelled through the queue. You can resubscribe for {days} days.
ex.label: Ex-subscriptions
ex.empty: No ex-subscriptions. Channels you cancel here stay for {days} days, ready to come back.

banner.server_down: Can't reach the plugin's server — the queue waits until it's back.
banner.ext_endpoint_down: The extension's local server is off — the queue waits until Hermes turns it back on.
banner.ext_disconnected: Browser extension disconnected — approvals stay in the queue until your browser opens.
banner.no_model: No AI model: reasons come from the rules and the Off-your-profile group is off. Pick a model and sign in under Settings → Models.
banner.provider_unavailable: Hermes couldn't reach your AI model ({route}): reasons come from the rules and the Off-your-profile group is off. Sign in to it again, or pick another model for “YouTube curator” in Settings → Model → Auxiliary models.
banner.provider_unavailable_plain: Hermes couldn't reach your AI model: reasons come from the rules and the Off-your-profile group is off. Sign in to it again, or pick another model for “YouTube curator” in Settings → Model → Auxiliary models.
banner.ext_not_paired: Connect the browser extension to bring in your subscriptions

empty.never_desc: Hermes looks for three kinds of channel. Nothing is cancelled without your click.
empty.clean_desc: No inactive, unwatched or off-profile channels in the last scan ({when}).

criteria.label: What the scan looks for
criteria.stale: Inactive: no new video in 180 days
criteria.ignored: Not watched: no video watched in 90 days
criteria.off_profile: Off your profile: far from your folders and favorites

toast.scan_unavailable: Scanning needs Hermes' AI from the Desktop backend.
